author: VANightingale
quote: Ive put nearly 6 hours in and I just can't finish it. The fps dips just hurt my eyes. The story itself ain't too bad. Jason is definitely a flat character though. Graphics are fantastic. But the way the game runs for me is just another story. Ive been through the launch of Cyberpunk and most Bethesda titles and the frames were better. I'm currently on the ps5.

author: VANightingale
quote: It's why I got my girlfriend athe Switch 2. Fantastic art style and graphics. Story is phenomenal and nostalgic. There's a reason why it's gonna win game of the year.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
